quest.title: Seagaze Sunset
quest.description: You hear about Sunset Vermillionite from Baizhu and decide to hit up Feiyun Commerce Guild for some information.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x750, Mora x28000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

chapter.title: The Crane Returns on the Wind

talks.objective: Go to Feiyun Commerce Guild to look for Xingqiu

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Master Xingqiu! Thank goodness you're finally back!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Oh? Why do I detect an urgency in your voice?

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: The Guild has had a whole string of strange orders in recently. Everyone's been completely caught off guard.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Your father gave me specific instructions to ask you to stay and help out if I happened to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I see. Have someone sort the orders by type for now. I'll deal with them myself shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Oh, how wonderful... Thank you, Master. With you on the job, I can breathe a sigh of relief.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Xingqiu! Glad you're here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We want to ask you for some information.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, please wait a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Xu, I need to entertain some guests. Please continue with your work for the time being, and we'll discuss the matter of the Guild's orders in more detail later on.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Understood, Master Xingqiu. Then I will leave you in peace.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I wasn't counting on finding you here today. What's going on? And how, pray tell, may I be of service?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xingqiu, have you ever heard of "Sunset Vermillionite"?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Oh, I see. So you've entered Lady Ningguang's contest as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "As well"? Do you mean...

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: The truth is, the Feiyun Commerce Guild is in possession of some Sunset Vermillionite, but only one piece.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: We are holding it on behalf of someone who has asked us to put it up for auction. And a lot of interested parties have already come to us inquiring about the price.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: At the end of the day, it all comes down to supply and demand. In this case, I'm guessing the final transaction price may be in excess of 500 million Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: 500 million!?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Honestly, I would recommend that you don't bother bidding on this one. The price is greatly inflated, and it's just not worth it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But without any Sunset Vermillionite...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Don't panic. I don't suppose you've ever heard of Sea Gazer?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Never heard of them.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Sea Gazer was once very close to Mountain Shaper. But if I am not mistaken, he has already passed away.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Yes, precisely... I didn't know anyone else knew about him.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: According to "Records of Drifting Clouds," Sea Gazer once built an abode to store his rarest and most exquisite treasures — among which was some Sunset Vermillionite.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: After Sea Gazer passed, the abode was abandoned, and its location was lost to time.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Luckily, I came into possession of a stack of folk history books just recently. They make some oblique references to this lost abode, and after cross-referencing them against each other, I'm now fairly certain that it is situated in the Lisha area.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's great! ...But is it really okay for us to just go and take his treasure?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wouldn't it be a little... y'know... disrespectful? With him being an adeptus?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: You needn't worry. As far as I understand, Sea Gazer was very open-minded. Even while he was alive, he wouldn't have let something like this bother him.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Open-minded...? I have not heard of Sea Gazer being described in this way before. May I ask where you read that?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Just a rumor I heard out in the mountains. Alright then, let's go.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hmm, there's something about this young lady that reminds me of a good friend of mine...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Oh, I almost forgot — adepti abodes tend to have very ingenious designs, especially when it comes to their defense mechanisms. Plus, it's likely to be crawling with monsters after being abandoned for so long. So please, be very careful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay! We will be. Thanks, Xingqiu!

choices.text: I don't think I can afford it.

talks.objective: Search for the abode around Lisha
Search for the abode around Lisha

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see... Xingqiu said it should be around here. But Paimon doesn't see anything...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: This place was hidden using a special adepti art. But now that I have removed it, we can inspect the area more closely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's amazing! Yep, let's take another look around...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! Is that a new Seelie over there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this it? Is this the Sunset Vermillionite?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's so huge...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true. But then again... why isn't it floating?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Plaustrite doesn't float until it's activated. It may look different from most ordinary stones, but it weighs around the same amount.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Only after being activated does Plaustrite reveal its true nature, breaking free from the shackles of the mortal realm and ascending up into the heavens.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Shenhe! You seem to know everything about this!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Only because my master is fond of chatting about these things. The moment she has some time to spare, she'll come straight for me and start telling story after story.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I don't care for her stories most of the time. I certainly didn't expect them to ever come in handy like this.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I wonder who this master is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on a sec! Paimon just realized something!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If we activate it here, there's no way we'll be able to get it back to the site, right? Heck, we'll be dragged up into the sky, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if we don't activate it, how else are we gonna lift it? This rock must weigh well over a thousand pounds, surely?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Don't worry. I can handle the weight quite easily.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you sure? Uhh, be careful!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Please, don't worry. I'm well aware that a Plaustrite sample this large must be highly valuable. I will be gentle with it and make sure it does not get damaged.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...My safety?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Paimon's sure you can handle it and everything, but if something this heavy lands on you, you're gonna get yourself hurt, no matter who you are.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You gotta be extra careful when lifting heavy objects. It's just common sense!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Is it, now... Well then, thank you.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I'll go on ahead with the Plaustrite. Let's meet at the building site later.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Shenhe lifts up the Plaustrite and leaves.

choices.text: It's your safety you have to be careful of.
It needs to be big to get the whole Jade Chamber airborne.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha... Weren't we at a waterfall just now? How did we suddenly end up here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So many clouds... It feels like we're high up in the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I believe this is the abode of that adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: With any luck, the Sunset Vermillionite we're looking for should be in here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Let Paimon see... Huh? Isn't that the Seelie from before?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, it's gone and snuck beneath the clouds!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And now that Paimon takes a closer look, the rocks and trees here don't seem complete... Could there be something below the clouds?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you think, Shenhe?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: These are not real clouds. They are the product of an adepti art used for spatial partitioning.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If we want to go down, we must first destroy the mechanism that is maintaining the adepti art.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Then let's do it!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I sense the presence of monsters in this place. I don't know where they are hiding, so we'd better be careful.

talks.objective: Activate the seal on the ancient array core

dialogues.speaker: Ju'an
dialogues.text: Hi there! Checking in, are we? You're just in time — we only have two rooms left.

dialogues.speaker: Ju'an
dialogues.text: Since this was chosen as the building site for the new Jade Chamber, we've had a constant stream of people in this area. And not just workers, either — visitors, business people, tea sellers, all sorts.

dialogues.speaker: Ju'an
dialogues.text: So business is booming for me today. Very few vacancies. You're lucky you got here when you did!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great!

dialogues.speaker: Ju'an
dialogues.text: One of your rooms is still being cleaned, I guess it should be ready within the hour. The other room is just through the door on the left.

dialogues.speaker: Ju'an
dialogues.text: Here are your keys... Alright, hope you enjoy your stay. Please excuse me, I'll leave you to it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shenhe, you should go get some rest. We'll hang around outside until the other room's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's gonna go see if there's anything good to eat around here... Hehe, Paimon couldn't help but notice one of the guests walk in with a huuuuge Grilled Chicken Drumstick before!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's buy one for Shenhe, too! She can have it as a midnight snack... or save it for breakfast tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Alright. I will head to my room for now.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If you need anything, don't hesitate to disturb me. I'm a light sleeper. I will hear if you knock on the door.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Mm-hmm. See you tomorrow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, isn't that Cloud Retainer? What's she doing here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go and say hi!

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One trusts you have met Shenhe. So, are you getting along quite well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So far so good, yeah... So you know Shenhe, too, Cloud Retainer?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Naturally. Save for Ganyu, who spends the majority of her time in Liyue Harbor, all the adepti living today are acquainted with Shenhe to some degree.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cool! So... what's her adeptus name, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Calling her "Shenhe" feels kinda friendly, but also kinda disrespectful. So Paimon's thinking, maybe it'd be better if we called her by her adeptus name instead?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Her adeptus name? Why, pray tell, would Shenhe have an adeptus name?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... don't all adepti have a special title they go by?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: On this latter point, you are correct. However... Shenhe is human.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, oh, right... Wait, what!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What? You knew already, {NICKNAME}? ...Ugh, so is Paimon the only one who didn't know?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Do you mean to say that she presents differently from ordinary human beings?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... to start with, her problem-solving methods are... extremely direct.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hah... Yes, she was like this all those years ago when one first met her. In this respect, she has not changed.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One first found Shenhe by chance in a cave. One was passing by and sensed the presence of a god's remains. Being of an ever-vigilant disposition, one entered immediately to inspect the scene.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Inside was Shenhe, then aged around six years old. In her hand, she held a dagger, with which she was confronting a monster that was the god's remains incarnate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds so dangerous...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: When one arrived, she had already been locked in confrontation with this monster for several days. Most mortal children are fragile, both physically and mentally, and are highly reliant on their parents for survival. But not so her.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: That she was able to endure such terrible danger was due not only to her strong willpower but also to the bloodlust and homicidal instinct with which she was born.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One dealt with the monster, yet she still refused to lower her guard. She even pointed her dagger in one's direction and remained ready to strike. Only after she was satisfied that one had no intention to cause her harm did she finally relent. She then passed out without uttering a single word.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In other words, if you hadn't passed by that day, Shenhe might have...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Not necessarily. Upon one's arrival, one could sense that the god's wrath was gradually receding. Even had the stalemate continued, one suspects that Shenhe may have still emerged the victor of the confrontation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's still so dangerous though! Why was a tiny little kid battling against the wrath of a god in the first place!?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Alas, the mortal world is rife with suffering of every kind, and she had experienced her fair share of this even at a tender age. Seeing that she was homeless, one decided to adopt her.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So when Shenhe talks about her "master," she means...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Indeed, it is one to whom she refers. Shenhe has an extraordinary constitution, making her well adapted to practicing the adepti arts. All the adepti cherished her talents, and so we were willing to train her.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: However, her homicidal urges did not subside with age. Rather, they grew stronger day by day...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Moon Carver once performed a divination for her. He declared that "Her fate is to bear the curse of calamity. Consumed by malevolent energy, she is prone to bring harm to those around her. Such is the magnitude of the danger this poses that her soul must be bound with red ropes to keep her homicidal instinct at bay."

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: The red ropes have indeed served to keep her calmer and more content, but also seem to have rendered her somewhat... inexpressive. Perhaps the red ropes are so powerful that they have suppressed some of her other emotions as well.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: It is only by fate that people's paths may cross. Now that Shenhe's path has crossed with yours, please be sure to treasure the gift that fate has given you, and take good care of her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhhh, now Paimon gets it. You came out here to check up on Shenhe because you were worried about her, didn't you?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hmph! You dare draw such a facile conclusion on the nature of one's present excursion? Incorrect. The truth is that while Liyue Harbor may seem peaceful today, danger is always lurking in the shadows.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ningguang once made a bold assertion that this is to be the era of the contract between Liyue and the humans... Well. One is most curious to observe how she will respond to the coming storm.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: If she handles it admirably, one is willing to be a witness to her achievements. But if she does not... the adepti shall not hesitate to seize control.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Let us conclude our conversation here for today. One has occupied enough of your time, and night is approaching. Be sure to get ample rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon neither! This is a real surprise...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, Paimon. I wasn't expecting to run into you out here at Guyun.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: What brings you here? You'll have to make it quick, I'm afraid, I really can't afford to chat for too long.

choices.text: What are you doing out here?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: As you can see, we're working on a construction project.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Personally, I consider this project to be of greater importance than the Jade Chamber rebuild. That's why I'm here to supervise.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I just hope we can complete it on schedule...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: A new type of Guizhong Ballista.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Ningguang commissioned an expert to dismantle and study the Guizhong Ballista, and design an improved version based on the original.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: This design is a step down from the adepti's original Guizhong Ballista in terms of firing speed and power, but the good thing about it is that it can be mass-produced.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It's also considerably easier to assemble and disassemble. This will allow for flexible deployment, whatever the location.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I'm confident it will prove very useful in dealing with future crises.

talks.objective: Land safely on the next level of clouds

dialogues.speaker: Changfeng
dialogues.text: That young lady who carried the Plaustrite in earlier... she's gotta be an adeptus, surely...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: A human raised by the adepti is precisely what Liyue needs right now. It is also what the adepti wish to give to Liyue.

talks.objective: Land safely on the bottom level of the abode

dialogues.speaker: Anshun
dialogues.text: I heard that Lady Keqing has gone to Guyun Stone Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Anshun
dialogues.text: She took a lot of our workers with her, too. So does that mean there's another construction project going on over there as well?

talks.objective: Continue onward to find the Sunset Vermillonite

dialogues.speaker: Leming
dialogues.text: Now we have the Plaustrite, the real construction work can finally begin! I think everyone's going to be very busy from this point onwards. Me especially.

dialogues.speaker: Leming
dialogues.text: Now we have the Plaustrite, the real construction work can finally begin! I think everyone's going to be very busy from this point onwards. Me especially.

talks.objective: Return to the Jade Chamber worksite to look for Shenhe
Return to the Jade Chamber worksite to look for Shenhe

dialogues.speaker: Changfeng
dialogues.text: Oh my god! I can't believe my eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Anshun
dialogues.text: How can she lift that massive rock all by herself? She's gotta be one of those adepti, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Leming
dialogues.text: O, mighty adeptus, please give me your blessing, so that in the coming year, I may reap a more bountiful salary...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: This is top tier, in size and quality, and the condition it's in is quite simply immaculate... Congratulations, this item is approved for submission.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I'm going to award you full marks for the "Sunset Vermillionite" item... May I take your name?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: My name isn't important. I'm not even here to compete.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I was just delivering this for some other people. They should be here any minute now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shenhe! And Ningguang's little helper!

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're the ones behind this. No wonder. The rarest talent turns in the rarest Plaustrite specimen.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: But I have to correct you on one point. It's not "helper." It's "secretary."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... Okay then, Miss Secretary, what do you think of the rock we found? Pretty amazing, right?

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: In truth, it is the finest piece of Plaustrite we have received so far.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: If everything goes according to plan, we will use this piece in the foundation of the Jade Chamber, which will enable us to proceed to the next stage of construction.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: As a side note, Lady Ningguang has rented some dwellings in the nearby area to serve as accommodations for the contestants. If you need a place to rest, you are welcome to stay there.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Now, please excuse me. As you can see, there is still a lot of work to do on the building site.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shenhe, Shenhe, just now on the way over, pretty much everyone was singing your praises!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...Oh really.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What kind of reaction is that!? So strange, aren't you happy about it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whenever Paimon gets praised, Paimon can't help but hold her head up high and break into a big, smug smile!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I've had similar compliments before.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: They call me an adeptus, treat me with great deference and respect, as if I'm set apart from the common folk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... 'cause that's how adepti are. At least, the ones we've met are pretty unique and reclusive, too. Way different than normal people.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: But I am not... Ugh.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shenhe?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I'm fine. I've been exerting myself quite a lot ever since we set foot in that abode. I'm just a little fatigued.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ummm... Well, Baiwen said that there are some makeshift hotels we can use, right? Let's go check in and take a rest!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: No need. I simply need to find myself a secluded place in the wilderness to sit and meditate in silence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can't do that! It's dangerous out in the wild on your own!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When you're hungry, you go eat something tasty, and when you're tired, you go lie down in a nice comfy bed, alright? Seriously, don't punish yourself like this.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...Okay. If you insist.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Great, now we're talking. Let's head to our hotel, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: Guest accommodations are far more comfortable than the wilderness.

talks.objective: Bring Shenhe to a nearby makeshift hotel to take a break

dialogues.speaker: Siqin
dialogues.text: We had a handful of scoundrels try to sneak in and steal some supplies earlier. I caught them, and they'll be dealt with according to the law.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: There seem to have been a growing number of tales told regarding Shenhe in recent years. Perhaps she was seen on the previous occasion when she secretly ventured out from the mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One has heard that a playwright in Liyue Harbor wrote an opera based on the legends told about her. It is called "The Divine Damsel of Devastation."

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The play portrays her as making a stand to protect her fellow villagers... Hehe, one can only surmise that every story needs a hero.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey... So, Shenhe...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...Master has relayed my situation to you, I take it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? How did you know?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I'd intended to wait until you came back before going to sleep, but I didn't hear you come in.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I was worried that something may have happened to you. So I went outside to check, and caught sight of my master.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: On top of this, you have been acting very strangely around me this morning, causing me to suspect that my master must have told you everything about me.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: After all, master is... very talkative.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... Sorry, Shenhe. Paimon had you down as an adeptus this whole time, but it turns out Paimon was wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It's okay. I don't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: The fault is mine for not explaining everything to you sooner. Because in my experience, trying to explain is a futile pursuit.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Still, though you mistook me for an adeptus, you never treated me as distant and unapproachable. Instead, you treated me as you would a friend...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: For this, I am very grateful indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To be fair, we've met our fair share of real adepti, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, now it's settled! From now on, you're our friend! Whether you're an adeptus or a human isn't the important thing — first and foremost, we're just plain old friends!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Got it. Although I don't know quite what it entails in terms of what I have to do, I must say I like the title "friend" very much indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Well, now that we're all rested up, we should start searching for the other two items on the list.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But before we do that, let's go to the building site and ask Ningguang's little helper how the progress is going.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After all, Sunset Vermillionite is so rare, Paimon doubts many competitors will really be able to find any. If it turns out some of them have given up already, we'll be able to take things a little more slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: It looks like the Jade Chamber rebuilding project will be fiercely competitive. It's difficult to say who will emerge as the winner.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Why does Lady Ningguang need so much wound dressing?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Is it really such risky business, rebuilding the Jade Chamber? This is all most peculiar...

dialogues.speaker: Changfeng
dialogues.text: The rebuilding of the Jade Chamber is a monumental task, and we are the ones who have been entrusted with this work. It is only right that we put our hearts and souls into this project.

dialogues.speaker: Anshun
dialogues.text: Normally, it would be Lady Keqing supervising the construction work. But it seems like she's been a little preoccupied lately...

dialogues.speaker: Leming
dialogues.text: First, we construct the keel of the Jade Chamber. The keel is the part that holds the Plaustrite, so once that arrives, it goes straight in...

dialogues.speaker: Lizheng
dialogues.text: Shh... Quiet! Can't you see that I'm concentrating here? Every brick is a crucial component! If I stop concentrating, I'm gonna lay a brick out of whack, and that'll put the whole darn structure out of whack, and then... Well, shoot, and then it's all over...

dialogues.speaker: Siqin
dialogues.text: I'm under orders to ensure the security of this location. It's imperative that construction stays on schedule. Hopefully, there won't be any setbacks.

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: We've been pretty active in the Millelith recently. I don't know what's going on but... I'd better be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: This is a matter of utmost importance. I must not let Lady Ningguang down...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you here to deliver construction materials?

dialogues.speaker: Lizheng
dialogues.text: You again? Can't you see that I'm trying to work!? Look, if you wanna chat, find me at dinnertime, okay!

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: I heard a good few of my comrades have been sent over to Guyun Stone Forest. I sure hope they'll be safe out there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How was Shenhe able to carry that huge rock all by herself!? Hmm... adepti super-strength, much?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, we can't slow down yet. Let's go meet her at the building site!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Shenhe isn't an adeptus after all. She just grew up around the adepti...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No wonder she doesn't like being treated as an adeptus. Having everyone falling over themselves to show their respect all the time must be kinda hard to deal with...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! And another thing, we bought some Grilled Chicken Drumsticks on the way back last night! There was a place just outside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here's one for you, Shenhe! Try it, they're so good!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...I concur. It has a rich flavor, far more agreeable than those I've cooked for myself in the wilderness in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Seelie got to here and then disappeared. Should we go over and take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It appears that we've been taken for intruders... This time, why not allow me to take care of this.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: The core of the mechanism is exposed. Now's our chance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, w—we're going to faaaall!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is everyone okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, the Seelie has disappeared beneath the clouds again!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It looks like we need to go further down. But before that, let's destroy the guard mechanisms on this level first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're gonna fall! This time we're really going to fall, aaaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So high... We can't even see to the bottom!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Luckily there was a pool of water at the bottom. Otherwise, that could have ended very differently...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, that Seelie's on the move again! Let's catch up with it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look over there, could that be the Sunset Vermillionite?
